blockers.owner: Interactive operator and Kiln Web/hosted-execution maintainers
prerequisites: Explicitly allocate an eligible host and preserve its kernel, whole-host trust, SMT/KSM and CAT gates; the workstation's Linux 6.18.50 refusal must not be waived.

Run exact-commit interactive approval through ordinary kiln-web-service, genuine native Lattice saved workflows and kiln-hosted lattice-job to actual approved-untrusted hosted execution; retain exact guest, outcome and teardown evidence. Caller-provenance execution.run and historical direct-route receipts do not satisfy this criterion.
blockers.completed: The superseded direct composition is removed. The sole-Lattice route passed a real local exercise: ordinary kiln-web-service, genuine saved native workflows via workflow-exchange serve, the fixed lattice-job task, and authenticated hosted Firecracker execution. Hosted independently verified the configured Web authority and exact Git source; the ineligible 6.18.50 host was refused before execution or financial effects. Controlled trusted execution returned source-bound guest stdout. Live HTTPS cancellation of a running VMM reached Cancelled/cleaned with destroyed journal and no owned unit, and replay/restart preserved outcomes and counts. Cancellation intent is now durable worker-visible state observed by both the task and hosted, because the native runner may destroy a cancelled task without a signal.
blockers.boundary: Approved-untrusted execution still requires an eligible allocated host; the workstation refusal is not VM qualification. Same-host trusted execution and cancellation are not production deployment, WAN/relay, distinct-physical-host or hostile-isolation proof. hostile_isolation_claim remains false.
